pages.text: BREAK leaves the innermost loop at once.$(br2)It works in FOR, EACH, WHILE and REPEAT loops. It may have a condition: then it only leaves the loop if the condition is true. A BREAK outside of a loop is a mistake.
Craft a NOOP block and a stick together.
$(1)FOR divisor INTEGER 2 ; candidate - 1 ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  BREAK candidate \ divisor = 0 ;$(br)END FOR$()
The loop stops as soon as a divisor is found.
